content: Templates saved our team hours when spinning up new client projects
Mobile Sync works for basic use but lacks polish compared to alternatives. Ticket #1002.
Push notifications fire twice for the same task assignment. Context: Notifications workflow on Flowdesk.
Project templates cannot be shared across workspaces. Context: Templates workflow on Flowdesk.
Cannot nest subtasks more than two levels deep. Context: Onboarding workflow on Flowdesk.
SSO setup docs are outdated and broke our Okta trial. Context: Permissions workflow on Flowdesk.
Calendar integration drops recurring meetings randomly. Context: Mobile Sync workflow on Flowdesk.
We are evaluating Asana because onboarding still takes a full week
If mobile sync is not fixed we will cancel at renewal
Love the clean board view — finally replaced our sticky-note chaos
